name: Pasta with Spicy Italian Sausage, Roasted Butternut Squash & Broccoli Rabe

instructions.primary_message: Blanch the broccoli rabe in a large pot of boiling, salted water for 2 minutes. Transfer to an ice bath to stop cooking. Drain and set aside (may be done a day ahead).
Toss the butternut squash with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with 1/4 tsp kosher salt and the black pepper. Transfer to rimmed baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes until golden and tender

Meanwhile, place a fresh pot of water on high heat for pasta. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12” skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add sausage, breaking up large chunks, and cook until browned on all sides.

Remove sausage from the pan, add the onions, season with 1/4 tsp kosher salt and crushed red pepper, then reduce heat to medium and cook until onions soften and begin to brown (add a little stock if needed to deglaze the pan).
While onions cook, add remaining 1 tbsp kosher salt and the pasta to the boiling water and cook until al dente.
Add sliced garlic to the browned onions and sauté until fragrant. Add the sausage and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, add pasta, stir to coat with the sauce, and adjust heat so sauce is simmering. Stir in the butternut squash and broccoli rabe, then simmer for 2-3 minutes more.
Off heat, stir in Parmesan, then taste and adjust seasonings as desired. Serve immediately, drizzled with remaining 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkle of additional Parmesan.
